verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows general marketing claims that a virtual mailbox address 'meets business registration requirements in most states' and serves as a legal business address, but there is no specific mention of bank or payment-processor acceptance, no KYC/proof-of-address documentation, and no statement of where the address does or doesn't work. missing for 10: explicit bank/payment-processor acceptance claims, KYC-compliant proof-of-address documentation, and provider-stated limitations on where it works.
